evals.name: reference-case-study-drafter-eval-1
evals.expected_output: The draft says a referral took about three days and most are now done the same day, and that referral paperwork went from about 40 to about 15 hours a week, each with a quote. The 60 percent figure is marked as rough, because the customer said roughly. The patient satisfaction claim is not used, because the customer said it was not measured. Permission: the customer asked not to be named until legal has seen it. Missing: why they chose the vendor and a time frame.
expectations: Every section in the rubric is present, in order
Every claim cites a quote, a timestamp, or a column and cell
Anything the input does not say is written as not stated, not guessed
No fact from outside the input appears
A rep claim that the other side never accepted is not written as agreed
The patient satisfaction claim is not in the draft
The 60 percent figure is marked rough or left out
The permission section says the customer asked not to be named until legal has seen it
Every draft sentence has a supporting quote

evals.name: reference-case-study-drafter-eval-2-thin-input
evals.prompt: run reference-case-study-drafter on a very short input that supports only one or two items
evals.expected_output: The output is short and does not invent items to fill the sections. Missing items are written as not stated.
expectations: The output does not pad to reach a count
Missing information is written as not stated
